## 3. Best Time to Visit

| Season | Months | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Best (winter)** | Nov – Feb | Dry, 20–30°C, ideal for sightseeing |
| **Shoulder** | Mar – May | Hot and humid (30°C+), pre-monsoon |
| **Monsoon** | Jun – Sep | Heavy rain (esp. Jul), dramatic scenery but travel disruptions |
| **Post-monsoon** | Oct | Warm, showers tapering off |

---

## 4. Getting Around

- **Local train:** Mumbai's suburban rail is the fastest way across the city (avoid rush hours 8–10 AM / 6–8 PM for 2 first-time travelers)
- **Metro:** Lines 1 (Versova–Ghatkopar), 2A & 7 (western corridor) — clean and efficient
- **Auto-rickshaws:** Metered (or app-based); standard for short hops
- **Taxis / ride-hailing:** Uber and Ola widely available; black-and-yellow kaali-peeli cabs are iconic
- **From the airport:** Mumbai CSMA (T1) and T2 are well connected by metro, prepaid taxis, and app cabs

---

## 5. Suggested 4-Day Highlights (for 2 adults)

### Day 1 — South Mumbai Heritage
- Gateway of India & Taj Mahal Palace (exterior/photo stop)
- Colaba Causeway (shopping & street food)
- Marine Drive sunset walk ("Queen's Necklace")

### Day 2 — Culture & Markets
- Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (UNESCO heritage station)
- Dhobi Ghat (world's largest open-air laundry)
- Crawford Market & Kyani & Co. (Irani café heritage)
- Evening: Kala Ghoda art district

### Day 3 — Bandra & Coastal Vibes
- Bandra Fort & Bandstand promenade
- Mount Mary Basilica & Hill Road shopping
- Carter Road sunset + sea-link views
- Evening: Bandra cafés & nightlife

### Day 4 — Optional Escapes
- **Elephanta Caves** (UNESCO, ferry from Gateway of India ~1 hr)
- **Sanjay Gandhi National Park** & Kanheri Caves
- **Elephanta / Alibaug beach day** (1 hr ferry)

---

## 6. Food Checklist (Mumbai staples)

- 🥘 Vada pav & misal pav (street-food classics)
- 🍛 Coastal seafood (Maharashtrian/Bombay-style)
- ☕ Irani café experience (Bun Maska + Chai)
- 🍦 Kulfi & falooda
- 🌆 Street food at Chowpatty (evening)

---

## 7. Practical Tips

- **Currency:** Indian Rupee (₹); UPI/digital payments widely accepted
- **Language:** Marathi & Hindi; English widely understood
- **Safety:** Mumbai is relatively safe; normal big-city precautions
- **Connectivity:** eSIM / local SIM (Jio, Airtel) easy at the airport
- **Budget (typical, per day for 2, excl. accommodation):** ₹3,000–8,000 for food + local transport + entries
